common_premise: Fixed R normal definitions; valid ordinary data unless the atom names failure. Source ranges are complete actual units read by the named reader; no plugin override or target execution.
common_cancel: Only actual reached branches are asserted. Skip, failure, return, callback cancellation and later UI cancellation are distinct.
common_failure: Earlier writes/callbacks remain after later failure; no transaction or unconditional final cleanup is inferred.
common_persistence: Current battle/session identity only unless the atom names a bound persistent object. Save/serialization/reload remains an independent receiver; NOT_EXECUTED.
